name: Benchmark: Global Cyber Breach Reports
note: Benchmark-owned copy of production Global Cyber Breach Reports (objective, query, schema). Harness reads PERIGON_MONITOR_ID (defaults to uuid).
monitoringObjective: Track major cybersecurity breaches and data leaks globally as they are reported in real-time.
prompt: Emit one distinct event per major cybersecurity breach or data leak affecting a named organization. List every organization reported as affected. Exclude general cybersecurity news without a specific breach victim, opinion without an incident, and vulnerability-only stories with no data compromise or unauthorized access.

query.q: ("cybersecurity incident" OR "cyber attack" OR "cyber-attack" OR cyberattack* OR "data breach" OR "data leak" OR hack* OR breach* OR leak* OR "security incident" OR vulnerabilit* OR exploit* OR ransomware OR malware OR phishing OR "zero day" OR "zero-day") AND (data OR information OR record OR credential OR password OR "personal information" OR "PII" OR "customer data" OR "user data" OR "sensitive data" OR system OR network OR server OR database) AND (compromis OR stolen OR exposed OR access OR disrupt OR infiltrat OR exfiltrat OR "unauthorized access")
